LanguageData.WGMonolynFemaleGay.EnabledLabel: Make all Monolyn female and gay
LanguageData.WGMonolynFemaleGay.EnabledTooltip: Replaces hereditary abstinence. Monolyn remain sterile but lose the hereditary abstinence romance penalty.
LanguageData.WGMonolynFemaleGay.Explanation: This is the same switch shown in Monolyn’s General settings. Turning it on turns hereditary abstinence off; turning hereditary abstinence back on turns this off. With both off, Monolyn retain ordinary gender and orientation, and remain sterile.
LanguageData.WGMonolynFemaleGay.StatusAbstinence: Current mode: hereditary abstinence (genderless and asexual)
LanguageData.WGMonolynFemaleGay.StatusSterile: Current mode: ordinary gender and orientation (sterile)
LanguageData.WGMonolynFemaleGay.Unavailable: Unavailable: the Monolyn patch could not bind. Check the game log for a contract error.
